messages:
maya: Heads-up — Orchid Labs filed a billing ticket: their client SDK estimator reports 68 tokens but invoice shows 193. They included a tiny repro (they usually stream).

sam: Can you paste the exact request they used and the invoice metering line?

maya: They send this payload (streaming normally):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
Authorization: Bearer <key>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-8k",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a brief assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Summarize the three action items from the meeting."}
  ],
  "stream": true,
  "function_call": "auto"
}
```

maya: SDK (v0.8.7) estimator returned: prompt=30, completion=38 => total=68
Invoice / metering record: prompt=82, completion=111 => total=193

metering-bot: metering entry req=req_7f1a: prompt=82 completion=111 total=193

dave: That's a big delta. Did the customer see any invisible chunks in the stream (e.g. server-side summary append, tool results, or postprocess blob)? SDK estimators usually only count visible user/assistant messages.

lisa: Customer says they saw a final assistant chunk but not the internal preambles. They were on stream mode so they didn't inspect headers.

maya: I repro'd with curl (stream=false) and added debug header. Response headers included: `x-metering: prompt=82,completion=111,total=193` and `x-injected: audit_preamble=28,post_summarizer=45`.

runtime-bot: Runtime log for req_7f1a: matched policy pattern -> injected audit_preamble (~28 tokens) before model run. After model produced assistant tokens we run a short post_summarizer step (server-side) that appends a condensed paragraph (~40-50 tokens) to the completion. Both are counted by metering.

sam: So SDK estimator omitted both server-injected preamble and postprocessing summarizer. That explains ~73 token gap.

dave: Two immediate support actions: 1) reply to customer with curl + header sample and explain server-side injected blocks are billed; 2) offer a one-time credit if invoice impact is material.

lisa: Engineering follow-ups: Runtime to surface `metering.hints` in body or headers when we inject tokens; SDK to add an optional server-aware estimator mode that requests a hint prior to counting; Billing to mark the support ticket for adjustment review.

runtime-bot: Filed INF-5012: "surface-injected-metering-hints + per-tenant opt-out for audit/postprocessing" assigned to runtime infra. ETA: 12 business days.

sam: Quick repro checklist to give customers: re-run with `stream=false`, add `X-Debug-Trace: true` header, capture `x-metering` and `x-injected` headers, and try a raw curl to rule out SDK estimator behavior.

maya: I'll send that to the customer and offer a goodwill credit while we ship INF-5012. Will follow up when we have a SDK PR. /cc @dave @lisa

dave: Also note: SDK v0.9.x will change estimator defaults — I'll draft release notes explaining visible-only vs server-aware estimator modes and link INF-5012.

metering-bot: Linked support case ORCH-334 -> INF-5012. Billing entry matches server metering.

participants: maya,sam,dave,lisa,metering-bot,runtime-bot
